title: Shockley Semiconductor Laboratory, sculptures of Shockley diodes and 2N696 transistor, June 2019
description: The photograph shows three sculptures of semiconductor devices at 391 San Antonio Road, Mountain View, California. According to a nearby wall-mounted historical marker the two on the left are four-layer diodes ("Shockley diode") and the third sculpture is a 2N696 silicon transistor. The middle sculpture appears as it would have been sold with it's protective cap. The leftmost sculpture shows the same device but with the protective cover removed so as to show where the silicon chip would have been located within the device.
author: Baltakatei

Shockley Semiconductor Laboratory, sculptures of Shockley diodes and 2N696 transistor, June 2019
The photograph shows three sculptures of semiconductor devices at 391 San Antonio Road, Mountain View, California. According to a nearby wall-mounted historical marker the two on the left are four-layer diodes ("Shockley diode") and the third sculpture is a 2N696 silicon transistor. The middle sculpture appears as it would have been sold with it's protective cap. The leftmost sculpture shows the same device but with the protective cover removed so as to show where the silicon chip would have been located within the device.
